title: GOAL: provider-agnostic executor pool (Claude models as first-class [[executors]] rows; Opus 5.5 first)
spec: Goal container. User 2026-09-23: models must be interchangeable, plug and play: adding or removing a provider or model (Codex account gone, new models) is a pool.toml edit only. Today [[executors]] rows are Codex-only in code (executor.start hands any non-codex pick to the Claude fallback; spawn.run_worker resolves model from [models][tier]; review/self-review rules key off the "claude:<tier>" prefix). Stages: S1 pool helpers + model-based review rule; S2 claude-provider dispatch. After S2 merges the Planner adds an enabled opus55 row (provider claude, model claude-opus-5-5) to .orchestrator/pool.toml.
acceptance: every stage task merged into goal/<this id> and the PR opened
.orchestrator/pool.toml carries an enabled provider=claude executor row for claude-opus-5-5
